items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the gate's verdict
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: Session A: start-run responded with run-started; run-progress showed awaiting-verdicts with effects 1-9 stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install, self-check, gate, all recorded; the gate effect's events were [regeneration-cycle/gate-attempt-passed].

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: Session B: R-1/C-1 concluded failed at the fence (fenced-path-matched-nothing); start-run R-1 of C-2 was refused -32000 run-already-started; run-progress listed R-1 once, for C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first awaits its verdicts
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: Session A: with R-1 awaiting verdicts, start-run R-2/C-2 was refused run-in-progress; run-progress R-2 returned run null and R-1 still awaiting-verdicts.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: Session A: after R-1/C-1 passed, start-run R-2 of C-1 was refused cycle-already-run; run-progress R-2 null, runs list only R-1.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: start-run at commit deadbeef... was refused not-a-commit; run-progress R-1 null; the stub builder's launch log was never created.

items.name: A run whose context does not respond on its seam is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: Measurement entrypoint replaced by a script that exits at once: start-run refused contexts-not-responding with data.contexts ["measurement"]; run-progress R-1 null.

items.name: Each handoff is handed in, unchanged and once, to every consumer, in its producer's order
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: Relayed handoffs began scenario-stamped positions 1 and 2 to measurement, then source-cut-pinned position 1 to regeneration-cycle and to measurement; gate-attempt-passed position 1 relayed once to measurement; every outcome accepted.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: Plan with a scenario-less spec file: stamp recorded with no events, checklist effect refused empty-checklist (Measurement's reply), run halted at checklist with reason refused-before-the-cycle; no self-check or fence effect.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: Plan with an unstamped third scenario: stamp effect recorded with three scenario-stamped events; run halted at stamp, refused-before-the-cycle, detail naming plan [01-001 01-002] vs stamp [..01-003]; only the stamp effect exists.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: Self-check exiting 3 with last line 'golden checklist differs': run failed, cycle.failure {stage fence, reason harness-self-check-failed, detail 'golden checklist differs'}; last effect is self-check (position 4), no fence or regenerate.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: Self-check printing 'SKIP bb-tools' exit 0: first self-check effect recorded with harness-self-check-passed, its event's skipped-checks ["bb-tools"] and detail containing the SKIP line.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: FENCED_PATHS 'impl harness/cycles' with no harness/cycles: fence effect refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, next effect fail-cycle recorded (cycle-failed), run failed with cycle at fence for fence-refused; no builder launch log.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Config committed in the cut, fencing impl and harness/cycles (both present): the builder room listed the plan, harness/config.sh and an empty impl; git showed 1 root and 1 commit and no impl or harness/cycles path in the object graph.

items.name: Each regenerate launches one builder and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Candidate red then green: builder log shows launch 1 (regenerate) and launch 2 (repair), launch 2 began after launch 1 ended; run awaits verdicts after gate attempt 2 passed.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Stub builder left a passing candidate and exited 1: regenerate recorded (detail 'builder exit 1') with candidate-digest equal to my own computation of the candidate digest; run awaits its verdicts.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Builder exited 0 with an empty scope: no regenerate effect, fail-cycle recorded; run failed, cycle failure stage regenerate, reason candidate-not-regenerated.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Regenerate timeout 2 s, builder sleeping 30 s: builder never logged its end and its pid was gone; run failed with cycle at regenerate for budget (fail-cycle recorded).

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Port held by my own HTTP server: gate effects for attempt 1 refused seam-answered-before-boot three times, each followed by a recorded gate-refusal; run failed at gate for infrastructure; the candidate's start.sh log never appeared.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Budget 1, red suite: gate effect attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed reason suite-red; start.sh log never written; run failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Budget 1, candidate with test.sh and no start.sh: gate effect attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed reason contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Budget 1, page without 'sauna': gate effect attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed reason identity-probe-failed (detail 'page has no configured marker').

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Builder left a background writer adding a RED file to its scope after exiting (present in builder-1/impl, absent in gate-1/impl): gate attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-passed; install digest equals regenerate digest.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Repair effect attempt 2 recorded (verification-repair); Regeneration cycle's store shows mounted-evidence [.../evidence-1]; launch 2 saw the clean room, previous-candidate and gate-evidence, and write attempts to both previous-candidate and gate-evidence failed while impl was writable.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, and no fourth builder is launched
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Every candidate red: builder launched three times; gates 1-3 failed; run failed with cycle at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted; no fourth launch.

items.name: Verdicts handed in are filed as given, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Handing in 01-001 pass 'booked' and 01-002 fail 'judged by the main session' with r-1: file-verdicts and file-score recorded; measurement-filed shows passes 1 of total 2 with those items and evidences; run passed with its cycle (cycle status passed).

items.name: An item the verdicts file does not name is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Verdicts file with only 01-001 pass: measurement-filed lists 01-002 verdict fail reason unreached, passes 1, total 2; run passed with cycle status passed.

items.name: Verdicts for a run that does not exist are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: hand-in-verdicts for R-9 refused no-run; run-progress R-9 null.

items.name: Verdicts for a run whose gate never passed are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: After R-1 failed gate-attempts-exhausted, hand-in-verdicts refused gate-not-passed; run still failed with no file-verdicts effect.

items.name: A second verdicts file is refused, and no builder follows the verdicts
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: After the first verdicts led to score-stage-failed, a second hand-in was refused verdicts-already-handed-in; no regenerate or repair effect after position 9 and builder launched only once.

items.name: Verdicts under a grader digest the run did not approve are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Hand-in with grader digest r-2 on a run approving r-1 refused grader-not-approved; R-1 still awaiting-verdicts with 9 effects.

items.name: A verdicts file that is blank is refused, and nothing is filed
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Blank verdicts file refused verdicts-not-readable; R-1 still awaiting-verdicts, no file-verdicts effect.

items.name: Verdicts Measurement refuses fail the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Verdicts naming 09-001: file-verdicts refused unknown-item as Measurement answered, fail-score-stage recorded; run failed at score for score-stage-failed; builder launch log shows only the one launch.

items.name: A context that stops answering halts the run, and nothing is recorded for that effect
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: Measurement wrapped to exit when asked measurement/derive-checklist: run halted at checklist, reason context-did-not-respond; effects only stamp and pin, no checklist result.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: R-1 failed at the fence and R-2/C-2 halted at checklist in one runner store; re-reading both 5 s after each start responded gave byte-identical progress (status, effect results, relayed handoffs).

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: Two consecutive run-progress readings of R-1 were identical, status awaiting-verdicts; runs-to-advance was [].

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Probe exiting 0 only for exactly one argument 'http://127.0.0.1:<port>' with the marker: probe log shows it got that URL; gate attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-passed; run awaits verdicts.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Suite creating and removing tmp-suite inside its directory: gate attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-passed; install digest equals regenerate digest.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: Self-check printing the legacy two-space SKIP line: first self-check recorded harness-self-check-passed with skipped-checks ['the oracle cannot judge this tree: a tool it grades is absent.'].

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: stdio, no PORT: gate attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-passed with boot-budget-seconds 30, boot-polls 1, answered-on-poll 1, identity-probe-result 'answered as the context'; no gate-refusal effect; run awaits verdicts.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Probe got two args: <runs>/R-1/gate-1/impl/start.sh and '30'; its GATE_STORE was <runs>/R-1/evidence-1/events.sqlite (outside gate-1), no LOYLY_ variable; the store check's single argument was that same file.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Red stdio suite (runner itself given an inherited GATE_STORE): gate-attempt-failed for suite-red; suite env had no GATE_STORE or LOYLY_ variable; probe and store check never wrote their logs.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Probe printing 'no response within the 30s boot budget' exit 1: gate-attempt-failed identity-probe-failed with that line in the detail; store check never ran.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Store check printing 'FAIL event 7 ...' exit 1: gate-attempt-failed identity-probe-failed, detail carries that line; run failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Suite exiting 0 only if $PWD/docs/plan/01-a/spec.feature exists: suite ran in gate-1 and passed; gate attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-passed; install digest equals regenerate digest.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: LOYLY_STORE_CHECK_CMD naming a nonexistent program: run halted at gate, reason effect-could-not-run; no gate effect result recorded.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs with store-check 'check-store.sh one' then 'check-store.sh two': both first self-checks recorded harness-self-check-passed, harness digests sha256:97c8... and sha256:3329... differ.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: Plan slice 01-a as a git symlink to ../spec/a: stamp recorded with 01-001 and 01-002, run did not halt (awaits verdicts); checklist items 01-001 and 01-002 with source docs/plan/01-a/spec.feature:7/:12.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: PLAN_SLICES '02' with slices 01-a and 02-b: only one stamp effect, of 02-b (02-001); checklist items only 02-001.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: BUILDER_IMAGE builder-clojure present: both launches got three args (room, instruction file, <images>/builder-clojure); regenerate and repair details name 'builder image builder-clojure sha256:2cc0...', matching my digest of the folder.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: BUILDER_IMAGE builder-clojure absent from the images directory: start-run refused builder-image-missing; run-progress R-1 null; no builder launch log.

items.name: Two runs handed one measurement history store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs when a history store is handed in, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: With LOYLY_MEASUREMENT_STORE H, R-1 passed, then R-2/C-2/K-2 with verdicts passed; Measurement started on H answered scoreboard C-2 with previous-cycle-id C-1; R-2 relayed from measurement exactly measurement-filed (pos 1) and scoreboard-reported (pos 2) to regeneration-cycle.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Probe at harness/probe.sh reading APP_MARKER from $(dirname $0)/config.sh: probe ran from gate-1 with the URL, printed 'marker sauna found'; gate attempt 1 passed; install digest equals regenerate digest.
